outputs.explanation: Panel A is a macroscopic photograph of intestines, not a plot of averaged data, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.
Panel B consists of H&E-stained micrographs of intestinal sections, not a quantitative plot, so the check does not apply.

Panel C contains a box plot of total polyp numbers (exempt, distribution already shown) plus a 3D bar chart of mean polyp number per mouse by diameter category across genotypes (n=8-18 per genotype). The bar chart represents averaged data across multiple mice but shows no overlaid individual data points, so this part fails the check.
Panel D is a Kaplan-Meier survival curve (line plot), which is exempt from requiring individual data points.

Panel E includes western blot images and a bar chart of relative GTP-bound Rac1/Cdc42 levels (with an error bar visible), representing averaged/normalized data without any overlaid individual data points.
Panel F shows immunohistochemistry micrographs, not a quantitative plot, so the check does not apply.

Panel G includes western blot/zymography images and a bar chart of relative expression (Asef, pJNK1, MMP9) with error bars and significance markers, indicating averaged data across replicates, but no individual data points are overlaid on the bars.
